job: Clean up the Forge conversation UI
primaryTask: Read a saved conversation and send a message or attached file to Forge

productPrecedent.name: Brutus conversation shell
divergences: Dedicated single-column chat replaces inherited two-column voice grid; composer remains at bottom.

referenceGap: spectrum-ai-chat selected source describes conversation controls but its supplied screenshot depicts the Spectrum marketing site. It cannot establish chat visual equivalence. Product precedent is authoritative.

defects.problem: Inherited grid overlaps the topbar with the chat panel.
defects.evidence: Before screenshot: topbar subtitle hidden behind panel starting at y129.
defects.expectedEffect: A single readable header and transcript fit in viewport.

defects.problem: Duplicate heading, full-width history row and three idle status messages compete with conversation.
defects.evidence: Before screenshot shows Forge twice, 0 turns, Ready, No turn running, Ready when you are, then a separate attachment row.
defects.expectedEffect: One heading, compact history control and expandable activity details preserve focus.

defects.problem: Mobile CSS makes Send a full-width row and leaves file attachment in a separate toolbar.
defects.evidence: forge.css at max-width40rem sets message and send to100 percent.
defects.expectedEffect: Grouped message field with attachment and send actions stays compact.
